item.title: Routinely Itemised: RPG #353
item.description: Stay up to date with the latest tabletop news, from the official Children of Time TTRPG announcement to Luke Gygax’s return to Greyhawk with Wizards of the Coast. Plus, the 2026 Origins Awards finalists, academic research into D&D and Marxist theory, and a chance to win D&D crochet kits.

item.title: 7th Sea 3rd Edition: Studio Agate modernises the iconic swashbuckling roleplaying game
item.description: Studio Agate has launched the Kickstarter for 7th Sea 3rd Edition. The iconic swashbuckling roleplaying game returns with modernized Roll and Keep mechanics.

item.title: The price of immortality: Jason Carl and Mark Meer lead $8,000 vampire experience in Los Angeles
item.description: Jason Carl and Mark Meer lead the premium Darkness Emergent event in Los Angeles. Geek Native investigates the 8,000 dollar luxury vampire experience and the haunted legacy of the Millennium Biltmore.

item.title: Fateforge Megabundle: A 5E dark fantasy haul from Studio Agate
item.description: Studio Agate pairs their latest Kickstarter with a massive Humble Bundle offer for Fateforge, delivering 69 digital items for 5th Edition tabletop roleplaying games.

item.title: Para Bellum launches Conquest First Blood new edition at Adepticon 2026
item.description: Para Bellum Games launches the new edition of Conquest: First Blood at Adepticon 2026. Discover how the mechanical reboot, individual activations, and the new comparative dice system are transforming the 35mm skirmish roleplaying game landscape.

item.title: Audio EXP 326: Children of Time Roleplaying, Trading Card Dark Arts and an 8000 Dollar Vampire Event
item.description: Join Audio EXP 326 for a look at the dark side of trading card games, Hunters Entertainment returning to its roots, and Warhammer 40k eleventh edition prep.

item.title: Check out the trailer for the 20th anniversary 4k release of James Gunn's cult classic 'Slither'
item.description: Classic horror fans will rejoice when they learn James Gunn's sci-fi comedy horror is returning for a sparkly new 4k release - and a slimy new trailer has just dropped from Vertigo Releasing.

item.title: Wyldwolf Games unveils Axis Saga: The War of Silence for Dungeons & Dragons
item.description: Wyldwolf Games announces Axis Saga: The War of Silence, a community-driven dark fantasy horror setting for Dungeons and Dragons 5E launching on Kickstarter this April.

item.title: Resolution Games replaces AI allies with "Bad Luck Protection" in D&D update
item.description: Resolution Games axes hirelings in a major tactical pivot for Demeo x D&D Battlemarked. The Warlock Update introduces Azruss Drevontir and a hardcore "One Shot" challenge.

item.title: New Cyberpunk RED reprint and free DLC bridge the gap to Edgerunners season 2
item.description: R. Talsorian Games has confirmed a major restock of the Cyberpunk RED core rulebook for mid April 2026. Under Line Manager J Gray the studio is bracing for a new wave of interest following the announcement of Edgerunners season two.
